name: Snow Moose
desc: A tall and docile animal with eyes that seem to perceive all things.\nLiving on the snowy plains, Snow Moose possess thick fur and sturdy antlers. At the same time, they are light on their feet and have a keen sense of smell, always able to dig up food from beneath the heavy snow and swiftly escape the pursuit of natural predators.\nIn the ancient fairy tales of Snezhnaya, Snow Moose are always gentle and amiable. On special holidays, they will infiltrate dreams, bringing children the blessing to "grow up well."
